pro.name: Catwalk Run
pro.blurb: String the catwalk, the pipes and the racks without touching down.

goals.title: High Score: 15,000
goals.description: Land 15,000 points in one 2-minute run.

goals.title: Pro Score: 40,000
goals.description: Land 40,000 points in one 2-minute run.

goals.title: Pipe Dream
goals.description: Grind the whole length of the big pipe.

goals.title: Grab the Container Hop
goals.description: Grab a trick over the container hop and land it.

goals.title: Graveyard Shift: 6,000 Combo
goals.description: Land a single combo worth 6,000 points.

goals.title: Collect S-K-A-T-E
goals.description: Find S, K, A, T and E: pallet gap, catwalk, container gap, truck well, settling pit.

goals.title: Find the 6 Spray Cans
goals.description: The crew stashed six cans round the yard: flatcar, catwalk ramp, pipe run, flatbed, barriers, bank wall.

goals.title: The Lost Tape
goals.description: Someone bricked up a room behind the hall's east wall. Find the hole and grab the tape.

goals.title: Gap Hunter: 8 gaps
goals.description: Discover 8 gaps around the warehouse.

goals.title: Container Hop
goals.description: Grab the C floating over the gap between the stacked containers in the south yard.

goals.title: Forklift Hop
goals.description: Ollie the forklift and grab the F over its mast.

goals.title: Catwalk Marathon: grind 5 seconds
goals.description: Hold one grind for 5 seconds (the catwalk rail is long enough).

goals.title: Night Shift Manual: 4 seconds
goals.description: Hold one manual for 4 seconds.

goals.title: Lights Out Special
goals.description: Land any special trick.

goals.title: Trick Variety: 5 different tricks
goals.description: Land one combo with five different tricks in it.

goals.title: Gap Chain: 3 gaps in a combo
goals.description: Link three different gaps in one combo and land it.

goals.title: Gap Rush: 3 gaps in 30 seconds
goals.description: Hit three different gaps inside 30 seconds.

goals.title: Mixtape: find 3 hidden tapes
goals.description: Three skate-video cassettes are hidden on landmark spots. Ride through each one.

goals.title: Pro Challenge Bronze: Catwalk Run
goals.description: Catwalk Run: land 3,000 points in the run, and one combo of 2,500+ points over one of its gaps.

goals.title: Pro Challenge Silver: Catwalk Run
goals.description: Catwalk Run: land 12,000 points in the run, and one combo of 5,000+ points over 2 of its gaps, inside 100 seconds.

goals.title: Pro Challenge Gold: Catwalk Run
goals.description: Catwalk Run: land 25,000 points in the run, and one combo of 9,000+ points over 3 of its gaps, inside 80 seconds.
